name: personal-ai-setup-devtools
description: Dev tooling only. This repo ships no JavaScript; package-lock.json exists so the markdown linter's ENTIRE dependency tree is pinned, not just its top-level version. `npm install -g markdownlint-cli2@0.23.2` pins one package and lets everything under it float, which is the supply-chain gap zizmor's adhoc-packages audit is about -- the same reasoning that made every GitHub Action here hash-pinned.
